purpose: A severity label using the shared critical, high, medium, low, and info scale.
behaviorProvider: Static severity label or named compact dot.

component: Map the five severity values to fixed labels and semantic foreground/border roles. Full badges show text.
Compact mode uses role img with a severity name and title; the dot is decorative. Preserve label meaning when replacing text with the compact presentation.
host: Determine severity from the product domain and document the criteria.
Use compact mode only where context makes the category understandable.
